run_quadruped_simulation: run the pybullet quadruped simulation that loads a minitaur robot and animates leg joints with sinusoidal gait
draw_inertia_box: use drawInertiaBox to render a debug wireframe box from a robot link inertia tensor in pybullet
control_joint_motors: use setJointMotorControl2 to control quadruped leg joints with position control and PD gains
create_link_constraints: use createConstraint to add point-to-point toe constraints between knee links on the quadruped robot
load_urdf_robot: use loadURDF to load a quadruped robot model with maximal coordinates and implicit cylinder flags
